subject: Re: Kickoff: HMC posterior reference - staffing + compute reality check
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Efe 60%, Maren 70%, Wanjiru 50%, Milan 40%, Rafael 25% (he's spread thin this quarter, so he's advisory on prior choice and chain diagnostics only).

Compute is the honest problem. Full-batch HMC is brutal - the published CIFAR-10 chains burned tens of thousands of TPU-hours. We cannot reserve at that scale, so the plan: run single long chains (which the paper itself justifies) on our cirrus-tpu quarterly allocation, budget ~40% of the portfolio's Q2 allocation, and scope M2 to CIFAR-10, IMDB, and UCI - not ImageNet-class anything.

Ines, cc'ing so you're aware data-platforms will be leaning hard on the cirrus allocation in April.

If the allocation math doesn't close by Friday I'll come back with a descoped M2.

Bruno
